device_entry.name: Yoctopuce I2C 端口模块
tags: 实验室自动化与仪器集成
实验仪器通信与驱动集成
嵌入式总线通信与外设控制
device_entry.description: 用于驱动和管理 Yoctopuce 的 I2C 硬件端口，可在实验系统中与各类 I2C 传感器、执行器或外围模块进行通信。支持设置总线电压与通信模式、发送和接收 I2C 数据、查询响应，以及在设备上上传和运行任务文件。
device_entry.description_en: A hardware I2C interface from Yoctopuce used to communicate with I2C sensors, actuators, and peripheral modules in lab setups. It supports configuring bus voltage and communication mode, sending and receiving I2C data, performing query-response transactions, and uploading or running job files on the device.
